+
+
+def test_schema_matching_with_records_in_arrays():
+    """https://github.com/fastavro/fastavro/issues/363"""
+    original_schema = {
+        "type": "record",
+        "name": "DataRecord",
+        "fields": [{
+            "name": "string1",
+            "type": "string",
+        }, {
+            "name": "subrecord",
+            "type": {
+                "type": "array",
+                "items": {
+                    "type": "record",
+                    "name": "SubRecord",
+                    "fields": [{
+                        "name": "string2",
+                        "type": "string",
+                    }]
+                }
+            }
+        }]
+    }
+
+    new_schema = {
+        "type": "record",
+        "name": "DataRecord",
+        "fields": [{
+            "name": "string1",
+            "type": "string",
+        }, {
+            "name": "subrecord",
+            "type": {
+                "type": "array",
+                "items": {
+                    "type": "record",
+                    "name": "SubRecord",
+                    "fields": [{
+                        "name": "string2",
+                        "type": "string",
+                    }, {
+                        "name": "logs",
+                        "default": None,
+                        "type": [
+                            "null",
+                            {
+                                "type": "array",
+                                "items": {
+                                    "type": "record",
+                                    "name": "LogRecord",
+                                    "fields": [{
+                                        "name": "msg",
+                                        "type": "string",
+                                        "default": "",
+                                    }]
+                                }
+                            }
+
+                        ]
+                    }]
+                }
+            }
+        }]
+    }
+
+    record = {
+        "string1": "test",
+        "subrecord": [{"string2": "foo"}],
+    }
+
+    binary = avro_to_bytes_with_schema(original_schema, record)
+
+    output_using_original_schema = bytes_with_schema_to_avro(
+        original_schema, binary
+    )
+    assert output_using_original_schema == record
+
+    output_using_new_schema = bytes_with_schema_to_avro(new_schema, binary)
+    assert output_using_new_schema == {
+        "string1": "test",
+        "subrecord": [{"string2": "foo", "logs": None}],
+    }

diff --git a/tests/test_repair_python_nested_union_defaults.py b/tests/test_repair_python_nested_union_defaults.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_repair_python_nested_union_defaults.py
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+import io
+
+import fastavro
+import pytest
+from fastavro._read_py import reader
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('container', ['array', 'map'])
+def test_python_reader_evolves_nested_records_with_complex_union_default(container):
+    writer_item = {
+        'type': 'record',
+        'name': 'Entry',
+        'fields': [{'name': 'value', 'type': 'int'}],
+    }
+    reader_item = {
+        'type': 'record',
+        'name': 'Entry',
+        'fields': [
+            {'name': 'value', 'type': 'int'},
+            {
+                'name': 'logs',
+                'type': [
+                    'null',
+                    {
+                        'type': 'array',
+                        'items': {
+                            'type': 'record',
+                            'name': 'LogEntry',
+                            'fields': [{'name': 'message', 'type': 'string'}],
+                        },
+                    },
+                ],
+                'default': None,
+            },
+        ],
+    }
+    item_key = 'items' if container == 'array' else 'values'
+    writer_schema = {
+        'type': 'record',
+        'name': 'Envelope',
+        'fields': [
+            {'name': 'entries', 'type': {'type': container, item_key: writer_item}},
+        ],
+    }
+    reader_schema = {
+        'type': 'record',
+        'name': 'Envelope',
+        'fields': [
+            {'name': 'entries', 'type': {'type': container, item_key: reader_item}},
+        ],
+    }
+    if container == 'array':
+        entries = [{'value': 7}, {'value': -2}]
+        expected = [{'value': 7, 'logs': None}, {'value': -2, 'logs': None}]
+    else:
+        entries = {'first': {'value': 7}, 'second': {'value': -2}}
+        expected = {
+            'first': {'value': 7, 'logs': None},
+            'second': {'value': -2, 'logs': None},
+        }
+    buffer = io.BytesIO()
+    fastavro.writer(buffer, writer_schema, [{'entries': entries}])
+    buffer.seek(0)
+    assert list(reader(buffer, reader_schema=reader_schema)) == [{'entries': expected}]

(
bash /testbed/mimo_test_command.sh
)
REPAIR_RC=$?
cd /testbed || exit 1
python -m pytest tests/test_repair_python_nested_union_defaults.py -q
REPAIR_NEW_RC=$?
if [ "$REPAIR_NEW_RC" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
exit "$REPAIR_RC"
